scope: Completed single-layer 32-step experiment; all-layer downstream results excluded

predictor.input: Y + supervision mask + normalized position features; log-RMS and padding validity also provided
predictor.output: activation gradient; analytically reconstruct full LoRA A/B gradients
predictor.offline_checkpoint_selection: minimum factor-balanced per-example A/B relative MSE on predictor_dev; every epoch

calibration.train_sampling: uniform without replacement from each current batch; RandomState(update_seed + 10000)
calibration.validation_sampling: fixed predictor_dev indices 0 through 15; separate from update batches
calibration.fresh_labels: recompute true gradients at the current LoRA state for both calibration and validation examples
calibration.checkpoint_selection: minimum individual factor-balanced A/B relative squared error + concatenated aggregate A/B relative squared error; equal term weights; ties retain earlier epoch
calibration.epoch0: retain the incoming predictor if none of epochs 1-30 improves the validation score
calibration.optimizer_state: reset at each batch in adaptive; retain selected predictor weights across batches
calibration.training_loss: individual factor-balanced A/B relative MSE + 0.25 activation-gradient MSE normalized by original offline target_scale^2; no aggregate training term
calibration.application: after calibration, predict gradients for ALL 32 current-batch examples
calibration.diagnostics: remaining 28 true-gradient examples are acquired after fitting and used only for diagnostics; not training or checkpoint selection

lora_update.aggregation: sum per-example sum-loss A/B gradients, divide by total supervised tokens, clip, then take one AdamW step

controls.fixed5: same 4-example calibration, lr and training loss; always keep epoch 5; predictor optimizer state persists; gradient validation measurements do not select its checkpoint

evaluation.generation_input: question-only prompt; reference answers used for gradient supervision, not generation prompts

limitations: Adaptive and fixed5 differ in predictor optimizer-state policy as well as epoch selection.
Three paired predictor/update seeds, not a full seed crossing.
Gradient-dev selection does not guarantee downstream improvement.
All results here concern one layer only.
